It is the worst property to stay . First of all the rooms were not same as shown in the images . They themselves denied that we don’t have that room and we can shift you to some other hotel . The other hotel was almost 500m away. It was also not that good . The service was very poor. Their kitchen was almost 100m away. They didn’t even provide water .
And in morning we need to go 100 m away for the buffet which we booked . All the meal was chilled and there were only 4 meal in buffet including khichdi.
I sincerely request you all to save your money and book some good hotels because we all deserve the best and not this shit .

I would strongly advise against trusting this hotel with your booking. Even after making full payment and receiving a confirmed reservation, they may still deny your stay at the last minute, claiming “maintenance issues.” Instead, they shift you to an alternate property that is significantly worse in quality and experience.

From my experience, this appears to be a deliberate practice — especially when room prices increase closer to the stay date. It feels like confirmed bookings made at lower rates are intentionally moved to accommodate higher-paying guests.

Very disappointing and highly unprofessional service. Book here at your own risk.
